name: Eco Lake Park Campground
evidence: Google z19 leaf-off at 39.1225,-85.7580 (Esri seam hides the south half): south spur pads end ~16 m from the lake with no road between, only open woods and a thin shore fringe; county park map draws the spurs at the north shore. ~4 ha dammed lake ~460 m long; kept lake over pond.

name: Charlarose Lake & Campground
evidence: Esri + Google z19 at 40.0843,-87.1078: 3-pad spur at the west end, ~30-35 m from water over open unused grass, no road, thin patchy bank brush; empty in the winter frame while seasonal rows stay full, so likely nightly. North loop ~47 m across two camp roads. Lake ~2 ha, so pond.

name: Buffalo Trace Park
evidence: County BTP_CG_MAP.pdf + Esri z19 at 38.4098,-86.0986: sites 44-47 lie inside the camp road arc that runs between them and the lake; 38-39 ~40 m from shore across a lit paved lakeside trail and picnic-table park lawn, so a day-use strip; water in open view from those pads.

name: Hardy Lake State Recreation Area
evidence: DNR Wooster Primitive map + Esri at 38.7732,-85.6903: site 155 (RA primitive drive-in, 40 ft, nightly) sits past the loop road on the point, pad ~15 m from the riprap edge with nothing between. Other Wooster sites and Shale Bluff are set back. Measured to high-water edge; 2026 drawdown ignored.

name: Johnny Appleseed Campground
evidence: Esri + Google z18 at 41.1125,-85.1185: nearest pads ~90-130 m from the St. Joseph, under trees, across Harry Baals Dr and a parkland belt of trees and brush (leaf-off shows the stems), plus a shelter; no open sightline earned, so the prior 50-90 m open bank read does not hold.

name: Richmond KOA Holiday
evidence: Esri z19 at 39.8708,-84.8628: north loop pads ~20 m from a ~1.5-acre fishing pond, but the camp's own loop road runs between every pad and the bank, then open lawn. Road rules out pond (AWH 2026-11-01), and a 1.5-acre pond is not a lake, so lakeview does not fit either.

name: Rising Sun Campground
evidence: Campspot map + API (mapIds, 2026-09-15): nightly RV sites F12-F20, F25-F38 are the field's west edge and south row (fire rings on Esri at 41.162,-86.557), ~110 m+ from the Tippecanoe through woods. Riverbank units (Esri 41.1622,-86.5545) are not sold nightly, so seasonal; don't count.

name: Pike Lake Campground
evidence: City of Warsaw site map + Esri z19 at 41.2485,-85.8395: all sites 1-45 sit inside the loop road; north row (19, 26, 30, 38) ~20-30 m from shore across that road and a grass strip with boat docks; none on the lake side. Own loop road blocks on-water; open sightline holds.
